data.title: Refusal of exemption for boat jetty
data.summary: Kreis Nordmuster (nature conservation department) rejected your application of 12 June 2025 for an exemption from the landscape protection ordinance to build a 14 m wooden jetty at Deichstraße 44. The letter is dated 1 September 2025.
data.explanation: The district refused your request for an exemption (Befreiung) because the shore is a breeding and resting area for protected birds, and it found neither an overriding public interest nor unreasonable hardship. You may challenge this by filing an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically with a qualified signature, or by recording it in person at the Kreis office. The app shows the deadline. Because the letter was sent by post, it counts as delivered on the fourth day after posting. Do not build the jetty without permission. Consider professional advice if you want to contest the decision.

items.title: Object to the refusal (Widerspruch)

date.text: innerhalb eines Monats, gerechnet ab der Bekanntgabe

items.action: File a written objection (Widerspruch) with Kreis Nordmuster if you want to contest the refusal.
items.consequence: After the deadline the refusal becomes final.
items.quote: Möchten Sie die Entscheidung anfechten, erheben Sie Widerspruch – innerhalb eines Monats, gerechnet ab der Bekanntgabe, schriftlich, elektronisch mit qualifizierter Signatur oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Nordmuster, Kreishaus, Marktstraße 1, 25813 Musterwik.
